faq: What makes a great Would You Rather question?Two choices that both deserve a second thought. Pick one, explain why, and invite your friends to defend the other side. There are no right answers.

How do you play a round of would you rather questions?Choose A or B to record your vote and see the real community results. Choose the other option to change your vote. If voting is unavailable, we say so instead of inventing numbers.

Are these would you rather questions good for groups?Start with the Classroom collection and check each question’s age rating and suitability for your group. Open Presenter Mode beside the live question for a shared display, use Previous or Next to move through questions, and Escape to exit.

Where can I find would you rather questions for kids, friends, or couples?Use the category cards and filters to open the collection that fits your group, then choose any reviewed dilemma to play in the live arena.
